row.evidence: Proofpoint sells every package by quote ('Budgetary pricing can be determined based on the number of user licenses and contract term'), and the only SCIM evidence is Okta's catalogue app for Proofpoint Security Awareness Training, which provisions users and groups; Proofpoint's own docs sit behind a login.
row.notes: Quote-only multi-product vendor (email security, Security Awareness Training/ZenGuide, DLP, Essentials for SMBs). Status is unknown, not gated, under rule 6a: the only SCIM evidence is Okta's OIN app for Proofpoint Security Awareness Training (SCIM ticked; Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push), and Proofpoint's own product documentation (help.proofpoint.com) requires a customer login. Microsoft's Entra tutorial for the same product lists SAML SSO with JIT provisioning only; Proofpoint on Demand's Entra app is SSO only. Collaboration Security packages (Core, Tier 2, Tier 3 with security awareness training, Prime) are all 'Request a quote'. The SMB product Proofpoint Essentials has a public REST API (X-User/X-Password headers) that lists, creates, updates and deletes users, plus Azure Active Directory sync settings.

scim.notes: Okta's OIN app for Proofpoint Security Awareness Training is marked SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (tick marks on the catalogue page, not quotable text). Proofpoint publishes no public SCIM documentation; help.proofpoint.com requires a customer login.

auth.notes: Username and password of a Proofpoint Essentials user sent in X-User and X-Password headers; permissions follow that user's role.
